en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washha, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, from Abu Hamza who said,

‘Ali<sup>asws</sup> is a door which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Opened. So the one who enters it would be a Momin, and the one who exits from it would be a disbeliever, and the one who does not enter it and does not exit from it would be in the layer (under a category about) which Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Blessed and High has Said:
‘For Me<sup>azwj</sup>, regarding them, is the (pending) decision’.
